She describes it as a reminder to follow her passions and express herself. Jon agrees with Gina, stating that it is important to have the freedom to express oneself without worry, and he shares that dancing gives him an escape to be himself, showing a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture. Jon responds that juggling his passions is tricky but rewarding, explaining that dancing and running his business require hard work and energy for each other. He states that dance moves energize him to tackle his business goals, and that successes in one area boost his drive to keep dreaming on the dance floor. He describes it as a balancing act but fun. Gina expresses admiration for Jon's ability to juggle his passions and emphasizes the importance of finding a happy medium, encouraging him to keep going and not stop dreaming. Jon thanks Gina for her pep talk, stating that it meant a lot to him, and assures her that he is not going to give up on his dreams of opening a dance studio and pursuing his business ventures, expressing love for having her in his corner and gratitude for her support.
